pixel_hash_basis: decoded RGB stored pixels, without EXIF transpose; dimensions recorded separately

limitations: No independent human adjudication or full transcription.
Merchant clusters do not prove distinct templates; shared POS layouts and unknown merchants remain pending.
Photo-like appearance is not confirmed capture provenance.
Contact sheets use stored pixels; the original-file viewer may honor EXIF orientation.
No OCR inference, benchmark split or training approval.
Personal information review remains pending; raw receipts stay local.
